# client-integration-nextjs.apollonextappprovider.md

Source: https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/blob/main/docs/client-integration-nextjs.apollonextappprovider.md

[Home](./index.md) &gt; [@apollo/client-integration-nextjs](./client-integration-nextjs.md) &gt; [ApolloNextAppProvider](./client-integration-nextjs.apollonextappprovider.md)

## ApolloNextAppProvider variable

&gt; This export is only available in React Client Components

A version of `ApolloProvider` to be used with the Next.js App Router.

As opposed to the normal `ApolloProvider`<!-- -->, this version does not require a `client` prop, but requires a `makeClient` prop instead.

Use this component together with `ApolloClient` and `InMemoryCache` from the `"@apollo/client-integration-nextjs"` package to make an ApolloClient instance available to your Client Component hooks in the Next.js App Router.

```typescript
ApolloNextAppProvider: _apollo_client_react_streaming.WrappedApolloProvider<_apollo_client_react_streaming_manual_transport.HydrationContextOptions>
```

## Example

`app/ApolloWrapper.jsx`

```tsx
import { HttpLink } from "@apollo/client";
import { ApolloNextAppProvider, ApolloClient, InMemoryCache } from "@apollo/client-integration-nextjs";

function makeClient() {
  const httpLink = new HttpLink({
    uri: "https://example.com/api/graphql",
  });

  return new ApolloClient({
    cache: new InMemoryCache(),
    link: httpLink,
  });
}

export function ApolloWrapper({ children }: React.PropsWithChildren) {
  return (
    <ApolloNextAppProvider makeClient={makeClient}>
      {children}
    </ApolloNextAppProvider>
  );
}
```

# client-integration-nextjs.debouncemultipartresponseslink.md

Source: https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/blob/main/docs/client-integration-nextjs.debouncemultipartresponseslink.md

[Home](./index.md) &gt; [@apollo/client-integration-nextjs](./client-integration-nextjs.md) &gt; [DebounceMultipartResponsesLink](./client-integration-nextjs.debouncemultipartresponseslink.md)

## DebounceMultipartResponsesLink class

This link can be used to "debounce" the initial response of a multipart request. Any incremental data received during the `cutoffDelay` time will be merged into the initial response.

After `cutoffDelay`<!-- -->, the link will return the initial response, even if there is still incremental data pending, and close the network connection.

If `cutoffDelay` is `0`<!-- -->, the link will immediately return data as soon as it is received, without waiting for incremental data, and immediately close the network connection.

```typescript
export declare class AccumulateMultipartResponsesLink extends ApolloLink 
```
**Extends:** ApolloLink

## Example

```ts
new AccumulateMultipartResponsesLink({
  // The maximum delay in milliseconds
  // from receiving the first response
  // until the accumulated data will be flushed
  // and the connection will be closed.
  cutoffDelay: 100,
 });
```

# client-integration-nextjs.md

Source: https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/blob/main/docs/client-integration-nextjs.md

[Home](./index.md) &gt; [@apollo/client-integration-nextjs](./client-integration-nextjs.md)

## client-integration-nextjs package

## Classes

Class

[ApolloClient](./client-integration-nextjs.apolloclient.md)

A version of `ApolloClient` to be used with streaming SSR or in React Server Components.

For more documentation, please see [the Apollo Client API documentation](https://www.apollographql.com/docs/react/api/core/ApolloClient)<!-- -->.

<tr><td>

[DebounceMultipartResponsesLink](./client-integration-nextjs.debouncemultipartresponseslink.md)

This link can be used to "debounce" the initial response of a multipart request. Any incremental data received during the `cutoffDelay` time will be merged into the initial response.

After `cutoffDelay`<!-- -->, the link will return the initial response, even if there is still incremental data pending, and close the network connection.

If `cutoffDelay` is `0`<!-- -->, the link will immediately return data as soon as it is received, without waiting for incremental data, and immediately close the network connection.

<tr><td>

[InMemoryCache](./client-integration-nextjs.inmemorycache.md)

A version of `InMemoryCache` to be used with streaming SSR.

For more documentation, please see [the Apollo Client API documentation](https://www.apollographql.com/docs/react/api/cache/InMemoryCache)<!-- -->.

<tr><td>

[RemoveMultipartDirectivesLink](./client-integration-nextjs.removemultipartdirectiveslink.md)

This link will (if called with `stripDefer: true`<!-- -->) strip all `@defer` fragments from your query.

This is used to prevent the server from doing additional work in SSR scenarios where multipart responses cannot be handled anyways.

You can exclude certain fragments from this behavior by giving them a label starting with `"SsrDontStrip"`<!-- -->. The "starting with" is important, because labels have to be unique per operation. So if you have multiple directives where you want to override the default stipping behaviour, you can do this by annotating them like

```graphql
query myQuery {
  fastField
  ... @defer(label: "SsrDontStrip1") {
    slowField1
  }
  ... @defer(label: "SsrDontStrip2") {
    slowField2
  }
}
```
You can also use the link with `stripDefer: false` and mark certain fragments to be stripped by giving them a label starting with `"SsrStrip"`<!-- -->.

<tr><td>

[SSRMultipartLink](./client-integration-nextjs.ssrmultipartlink.md)

A convenient combination of `RemoveMultipartDirectivesLink` and `AccumulateMultipartResponsesLink`<!-- -->.

## Functions

Function

[registerApolloClient(makeClient)](./client-integration-nextjs.registerapolloclient.md)

&gt; This export is only available in React Server Components

Ensures that you can always access the same instance of ApolloClient during RSC for an ongoing request, while always returning a new instance for different requests.

## Interfaces

Interface

[PreloadQueryComponent](./client-integration-nextjs.preloadquerycomponent.md)

Preloads data in React Server Components to be hydrated in Client Components.

\#\#\# Example with `queryRef` `ClientChild` would call `useReadQuery` with the `queryRef`<!-- -->, the `Suspense` boundary is optional:

```jsx
<PreloadQuery
   query={QUERY}
   variables={{
     foo: 1
   }}
 >
  {(queryRef) => (
    <Suspense fallback={<>loading</>}>
      <ClientChild queryRef={queryRef} />
    </Suspense>
  )}
</PreloadQuery>
```
\#\#\# Example for `useSuspenseQuery` `ClientChild` would call the same query with `useSuspenseQuery`<!-- -->, the `Suspense` boundary is optional:

```jsx
 <PreloadQuery
   query={QUERY}
   variables={{
     foo: 1
   }}
 >
   <Suspense fallback={<>loading</>}>
     <ClientChild />
   </Suspense>
 </PreloadQuery>
```

<tr><td>

[TransportedQueryRef](./client-integration-nextjs.transportedqueryref.md)

A `TransportedQueryRef` is an opaque object accessible via renderProp within `PreloadQuery`<!-- -->.

A child client component reading the `TransportedQueryRef` via useReadQuery will suspend until the promise resolves.

## Namespaces

Namespace

[ApolloClient](./client-integration-nextjs.apolloclient.md)

## Variables

Variable

[ApolloNextAppProvider](./client-integration-nextjs.apollonextappprovider.md)

&gt; This export is only available in React Client Components

A version of `ApolloProvider` to be used with the Next.js App Router.

As opposed to the normal `ApolloProvider`<!-- -->, this version does not require a `client` prop, but requires a `makeClient` prop instead.

Use this component together with `ApolloClient` and `InMemoryCache` from the `"@apollo/client-integration-nextjs"` package to make an ApolloClient instance available to your Client Component hooks in the Next.js App Router.

<tr><td>

[resetApolloClientSingletons](./client-integration-nextjs.resetapolloclientsingletons.md)

&gt; This export is only available in React Client Components

Resets the singleton instances created for the Apollo SSR data transport and caches.

To be used in testing only, like

```ts
afterEach(resetApolloClientSingletons);
```

## Type Aliases

Type Alias

[PreloadQueryProps](./client-integration-nextjs.preloadqueryprops.md)

# client-integration-nextjs.preloadquerycomponent.md

Source: https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/blob/main/docs/client-integration-nextjs.preloadquerycomponent.md

[Home](./index.md) &gt; [@apollo/client-integration-nextjs](./client-integration-nextjs.md) &gt; [PreloadQueryComponent](./client-integration-nextjs.preloadquerycomponent.md)

## PreloadQueryComponent interface

Preloads data in React Server Components to be hydrated in Client Components.

\#\#\# Example with `queryRef` `ClientChild` would call `useReadQuery` with the `queryRef`<!-- -->, the `Suspense` boundary is optional:

```jsx
<PreloadQuery
   query={QUERY}
   variables={{
     foo: 1
   }}
 >
  {(queryRef) => (
    <Suspense fallback={<>loading</>}>
      <ClientChild queryRef={queryRef} />
    </Suspense>
  )}
</PreloadQuery>
```
\#\#\# Example for `useSuspenseQuery` `ClientChild` would call the same query with `useSuspenseQuery`<!-- -->, the `Suspense` boundary is optional:

```jsx
 <PreloadQuery
   query={QUERY}
   variables={{
     foo: 1
   }}
 >
   <Suspense fallback={<>loading</>}>
     <ClientChild />
   </Suspense>
 </PreloadQuery>
```

```typescript
export interface PreloadQueryComponent 
```

# client-integration-nextjs.registerapolloclient.md

Source: https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/blob/main/docs/client-integration-nextjs.registerapolloclient.md

[Home](./index.md) &gt; [@apollo/client-integration-nextjs](./client-integration-nextjs.md) &gt; [registerApolloClient](./client-integration-nextjs.registerapolloclient.md)

## registerApolloClient() function

&gt; This export is only available in React Server Components

Ensures that you can always access the same instance of ApolloClient during RSC for an ongoing request, while always returning a new instance for different requests.

```typescript
export declare function registerApolloClient<ApolloClientOrPromise extends Promise<ApolloClient> | ApolloClient>(makeClient: () => ApolloClientOrPromise): {
    getClient: () => ApolloClientOrPromise;
    query: Awaited<ApolloClientOrPromise>["query"];
    PreloadQuery: PreloadQueryComponent;
};
```

## Parameters

Parameter

Type

makeClient

() =&gt; ApolloClientOrPromise

**Returns:**

{ getClient: () =&gt; ApolloClientOrPromise; query: Awaited&lt;ApolloClientOrPromise&gt;\["query"\]; PreloadQuery: [PreloadQueryComponent](./client-integration-nextjs.preloadquerycomponent.md)<!-- -->; }

## Example

```ts
export const { getClient, query, PreloadQuery } = registerApolloClient(() => {
  return new ApolloClient({
    cache: new InMemoryCache(),
    link: new HttpLink({
      uri: "http://example.com/api/graphql",
    }),
  });
});
```

# client-integration-nextjs.removemultipartdirectiveslink.md

Source: https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/blob/main/docs/client-integration-nextjs.removemultipartdirectiveslink.md

[Home](./index.md) &gt; [@apollo/client-integration-nextjs](./client-integration-nextjs.md) &gt; [RemoveMultipartDirectivesLink](./client-integration-nextjs.removemultipartdirectiveslink.md)

## RemoveMultipartDirectivesLink class

This link will (if called with `stripDefer: true`<!-- -->) strip all `@defer` fragments from your query.

This is used to prevent the server from doing additional work in SSR scenarios where multipart responses cannot be handled anyways.

You can exclude certain fragments from this behavior by giving them a label starting with `"SsrDontStrip"`<!-- -->. The "starting with" is important, because labels have to be unique per operation. So if you have multiple directives where you want to override the default stipping behaviour, you can do this by annotating them like

```graphql
query myQuery {
  fastField
  ... @defer(label: "SsrDontStrip1") {
    slowField1
  }
  ... @defer(label: "SsrDontStrip2") {
    slowField2
  }
}
```
You can also use the link with `stripDefer: false` and mark certain fragments to be stripped by giving them a label starting with `"SsrStrip"`<!-- -->.

```typescript
export declare class RemoveMultipartDirectivesLink extends ApolloLink 
```
**Extends:** ApolloLink

## Example

```ts
new RemoveMultipartDirectivesLink({
  // Whether to strip fragments with `@defer` directives
  // from queries before sending them to the server.
  //
  // Defaults to `true`.
  //
  // Can be overwritten by adding a label starting
  // with either `"SsrDontStrip"` or `"SsrStrip"` to the
  // directive.
  stripDefer: true,
});
```

# client-integration-nextjs.ssrmultipartlink.md

Source: https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/blob/main/docs/client-integration-nextjs.ssrmultipartlink.md

## SSRMultipartLink class

A convenient combination of `RemoveMultipartDirectivesLink` and `AccumulateMultipartResponsesLink`<!-- -->.

```typescript
export declare class SSRMultipartLink extends ApolloLink 
```
**Extends:** ApolloLink

## Example

```ts
new SSRMultipartLink({
  // Whether to strip fragments with `@defer` directives
  // from queries before sending them to the server.
  //
  // Defaults to `true`.
  //
  // Can be overwritten by adding a label starting
  // with either `"SsrDontStrip"` or `"SsrStrip"` to the
  // directive.
  stripDefer: true,
  // The maximum delay in milliseconds
  // from receiving the first response
  // until the accumulated data will be flushed
  // and the connection will be closed.
  //
  // Defaults to `0`.
  //
  cutoffDelay: 100,
});
```

## TransportedQueryRef interface

A `TransportedQueryRef` is an opaque object accessible via renderProp within `PreloadQuery`<!-- -->.

A child client component reading the `TransportedQueryRef` via useReadQuery will suspend until the promise resolves.

```typescript
export interface TransportedQueryRef<TData = unknown, TVariables extends OperationVariables = OperationVariables> extends QueryRef<TData, TVariables> 
```
**Extends:** QueryRef&lt;TData, TVariables&gt;

# client-react-streaming.buildmanualdatatransport.md

Source: https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/blob/main/docs/client-react-streaming.buildmanualdatatransport.md

[Home](./index.md) &gt; [@apollo/client-react-streaming](./client-react-streaming.md) &gt; [buildManualDataTransport](./client-react-streaming.buildmanualdatatransport.md)

## buildManualDataTransport() function

&gt; This export is only available in React Client Components

Creates a "manual" Data Transport, to be used with `WrapApolloProvider`<!-- -->.

```typescript
buildManualDataTransport: (args: ManualDataTransportOptions) => DataTransportProviderImplementation<HydrationContextOptions>
```

## Parameters

Parameter

Type

args

ManualDataTransportOptions

**Returns:**

[DataTransportProviderImplementation](./client-react-streaming.datatransportproviderimplementation.md)<!-- -->&lt;[HydrationContextOptions](./client-react-streaming.hydrationcontextoptions.md)<!-- -->&gt;

## Remarks

\#\#\# Drawbacks

While this Data Transport enables streaming SSR, it has some conceptual drawbacks:

- It does not have a way of keeping your connection open if your application already finished, but there are still ongoing queries that might need to be transported over. - This can happen if a component renders `useBackgroundQuery`<!-- -->, but does not read the `queryRef` with `useReadQuery` - These "cut off" queries will be restarted in the browser once the browser's `load` event happens - If the `useInsertHtml` doesn't immediately flush data to the browser, the browser might already attain "newer" data through queries triggered by user interaction. - This delayed behaviour is the case with the Next.js `ServerInsertedHTMLContext` and in the example Vite implementation. - In this, case, older data from the server might overwrite newer data in the browser. This is minimized by simulating ongoing queries in the browser once the information of a started query is transported over. If the browser would try to trigger the exact same query, query deduplication would make the browser wait for the server query to resolve instead. - For more timing-related details, see https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/pull/9

To fully work around these drawbacks, React needs to add "data injection into the stream" to it's public API, which is not the case today. We provide an \[example with a patched React version\](https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/blob/main/integration-test/experimental-react) to showcase how that could look.

## Example 1

For usage examples, see the implementation of the `@apollo/client-integration-nextjs` \[`ApolloNextAppProvider`<!-- -->\](https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/blob/c0715a05cf8ca29a3cbb9ce294cdcbc5ce251b2e/packages/experimental-nextjs-app-support/src/ApolloNextAppProvider.ts)

```tsx
export const ApolloNextAppProvider = WrapApolloProvider(
  buildManualDataTransport({
    useInsertHtml() {
      const insertHtml = useContext(ServerInsertedHTMLContext);
      if (!insertHtml) {
        throw new Error(
          "ApolloNextAppProvider cannot be used outside of the Next App Router!"
        );
      }
      return insertHtml;
    },
  })
);
```

## Example 2

Another usage example is our integration example with Vite and streaming SSR, which you can find at https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/tree/main/integration-test/vite-streaming

---

# client-react-streaming.datatransportproviderimplementation.md

Source: https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/blob/main/docs/client-react-streaming.datatransportproviderimplementation.md

[Home](./index.md) &gt; [@apollo/client-react-streaming](./client-react-streaming.md) &gt; [DataTransportProviderImplementation](./client-react-streaming.datatransportproviderimplementation.md)

## DataTransportProviderImplementation type

Interface to be implemented by a custom data transport component, for usage with `WrapApolloProvider`<!-- -->.

This component needs to provide a `DataTransportContext` to it's children.

See for example https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/blob/37feeaa9aea69b90a974eb9cd0fbd636b62d841a/integration-test/experimental-react/src/WrappedApolloProvider.tsx

```typescript
export type DataTransportProviderImplementation<ExtraProps = {}> = React.FC<{
    onQueryEvent?: (event: QueryEvent) => void;
    rerunSimulatedQueries?: () => void;
    registerDispatchRequestStarted?: (callback: (query: {
        event: Extract<QueryEvent, {
            type: "started";
        }>;
        observable: Observable<Exclude<QueryEvent, {
            type: "started";
        }>>;
    }) => void) => void;
    children: React.ReactNode;
} & ExtraProps>;
```
**References:** [QueryEvent](./client-react-streaming.queryevent.md)

# client-react-streaming.debouncemultipartresponseslink.md

Source: https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/blob/main/docs/client-react-streaming.debouncemultipartresponseslink.md

[Home](./index.md) &gt; [@apollo/client-react-streaming](./client-react-streaming.md) &gt; [DebounceMultipartResponsesLink](./client-react-streaming.debouncemultipartresponseslink.md)

## DebounceMultipartResponsesLink class

This link can be used to "debounce" the initial response of a multipart request. Any incremental data received during the `cutoffDelay` time will be merged into the initial response.

After `cutoffDelay`<!-- -->, the link will return the initial response, even if there is still incremental data pending, and close the network connection.

If `cutoffDelay` is `0`<!-- -->, the link will immediately return data as soon as it is received, without waiting for incremental data, and immediately close the network connection.

```typescript
export declare class AccumulateMultipartResponsesLink extends ApolloLink 
```
**Extends:** ApolloLink

## Example

```ts
new AccumulateMultipartResponsesLink({
  // The maximum delay in milliseconds
  // from receiving the first response
  // until the accumulated data will be flushed
  // and the connection will be closed.
  cutoffDelay: 100,
 });
```

## Constructors

Constructor

Modifiers

[(constructor)(config)](./client-react-streaming.debouncemultipartresponseslink._constructor_.md)

Constructs a new instance of the `AccumulateMultipartResponsesLink` class

## Methods

Method

Modifiers

[request(operation, forward)](./client-react-streaming.debouncemultipartresponseslink.request.md)

# client-react-streaming.md

Source: https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/blob/main/docs/client-react-streaming.md

[Home](./index.md) &gt; [@apollo/client-react-streaming](./client-react-streaming.md)

## client-react-streaming package

This package provides building blocks to create framework-level integration of Apollo Client with React's streaming SSR. See the \[@<!-- -->apollo/client-integration-nextjs\](https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/tree/main/packages/nextjs) package as an example.

It can also be used to use Apollo Client with a custom streaming SSR setup, e.g. with Vite. See the \[vite streaming integration test\](https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/tree/main/integration-test/vite-streaming) as an example.

## Classes

Class

[ApolloClient](./client-react-streaming.apolloclient.md)

A version of `ApolloClient` to be used with streaming SSR or in React Server Components.

For more documentation, please see [the Apollo Client API documentation](https://www.apollographql.com/docs/react/api/core/ApolloClient)<!-- -->.

<tr><td>

[DebounceMultipartResponsesLink](./client-react-streaming.debouncemultipartresponseslink.md)

This link can be used to "debounce" the initial response of a multipart request. Any incremental data received during the `cutoffDelay` time will be merged into the initial response.

After `cutoffDelay`<!-- -->, the link will return the initial response, even if there is still incremental data pending, and close the network connection.

If `cutoffDelay` is `0`<!-- -->, the link will immediately return data as soon as it is received, without waiting for incremental data, and immediately close the network connection.

<tr><td>

[InMemoryCache](./client-react-streaming.inmemorycache.md)

A version of `InMemoryCache` to be used with streaming SSR.

For more documentation, please see [the Apollo Client API documentation](https://www.apollographql.com/docs/react/api/cache/InMemoryCache)<!-- -->.

<tr><td>

[ReadFromReadableStreamLink](./client-react-streaming.readfromreadablestreamlink.md)

A link that allows the response to be read from a readable stream, e.g. for hydration of a multipart response from RSC or a server loader in the browser.

<tr><td>

[RemoveMultipartDirectivesLink](./client-react-streaming.removemultipartdirectiveslink.md)

This link will (if called with `stripDefer: true`<!-- -->) strip all `@defer` fragments from your query.

This is used to prevent the server from doing additional work in SSR scenarios where multipart responses cannot be handled anyways.

You can exclude certain fragments from this behavior by giving them a label starting with `"SsrDontStrip"`<!-- -->. The "starting with" is important, because labels have to be unique per operation. So if you have multiple directives where you want to override the default stipping behaviour, you can do this by annotating them like

```graphql
query myQuery {
  fastField
  ... @defer(label: "SsrDontStrip1") {
    slowField1
  }
  ... @defer(label: "SsrDontStrip2") {
    slowField2
  }
}
```
You can also use the link with `stripDefer: false` and mark certain fragments to be stripped by giving them a label starting with `"SsrStrip"`<!-- -->.

<tr><td>

[SSRMultipartLink](./client-react-streaming.ssrmultipartlink.md)

A convenient combination of `RemoveMultipartDirectivesLink` and `AccumulateMultipartResponsesLink`<!-- -->.

<tr><td>

[TeeToReadableStreamLink](./client-react-streaming.teetoreadablestreamlink.md)

A link that allows the request to be cloned into a readable stream, e.g. for transport of multipart responses from RSC or a server loader to the browser.

[registerApolloClient(makeClient)](./client-react-streaming.registerapolloclient.md)

&gt; This export is only available in React Server Components

Ensures that you can always access the same instance of ApolloClient during RSC for an ongoing request, while always returning a new instance for different requests.

<tr><td>

[registerLateInitializingQueue(key, callback)](./client-react-streaming.registerlateinitializingqueue.md)

Registers a queue that can be filled with data before it has actually been initialized with this function. Before calling this function, `window[key]` can just be handled as an array of data. When calling this funcation, all accumulated data will be passed to the callback. After calling this function, `window[key]` will be an object with a `push` method that will call the callback with the data.

<tr><td>

[resetApolloSingletons()](./client-react-streaming.resetapollosingletons.md)

&gt; This export is only available in React Client Components

Resets the singleton instances created for the Apollo SSR data transport and caches.

To be used in testing only, like

```ts
afterEach(resetApolloSingletons);
```

<tr><td>

[resetManualSSRApolloSingletons()](./client-react-streaming.resetmanualssrapollosingletons.md)

&gt; This export is only available in React Client Components

Resets the singleton instances created for the Apollo SSR data transport and caches.

To be used in testing only, like

```ts
afterEach(resetManualSSRApolloSingletons);
```

<tr><td>

[reviveTransportedQueryRef(queryRef, client)](./client-react-streaming.revivetransportedqueryref.md)

<tr><td>

[skipDataTransport(context)](./client-react-streaming.skipdatatransport.md)

Apply to a context to prevent this operation from being transported over the SSR data transport mechanism.

<tr><td>

[teeToReadableStream(onLinkHit, context)](./client-react-streaming.teetoreadablestream.md)

Apply to a context that will be passed to a link chain containing `TeeToReadableStreamLink`<!-- -->.

<tr><td>

[useWrapTransportedQueryRef(queryRef)](./client-react-streaming.usewraptransportedqueryref.md)

<tr><td>

[WrapApolloProvider(TransportProvider)](./client-react-streaming.wrapapolloprovider.md)

&gt; This export is only available in React Client Components

Creates an ApolloProvider for streaming SSR.

## Interfaces

Interface

[HydrationContextOptions](./client-react-streaming.hydrationcontextoptions.md)

<tr><td>

[PreloadQueryComponent](./client-react-streaming.preloadquerycomponent.md)

Preloads data in React Server Components to be hydrated in Client Components.

\#\#\# Example with `queryRef` `ClientChild` would call `useReadQuery` with the `queryRef`<!-- -->, the `Suspense` boundary is optional:

```jsx
<PreloadQuery
   query={QUERY}
   variables={{
     foo: 1
   }}
 >
  {(queryRef) => (
    <Suspense fallback={<>loading</>}>
      <ClientChild queryRef={queryRef} />
    </Suspense>
  )}
</PreloadQuery>
```
\#\#\# Example for `useSuspenseQuery` `ClientChild` would call the same query with `useSuspenseQuery`<!-- -->, the `Suspense` boundary is optional:

```jsx
 <PreloadQuery
   query={QUERY}
   variables={{
     foo: 1
   }}
 >
   <Suspense fallback={<>loading</>}>
     <ClientChild />
   </Suspense>
 </PreloadQuery>
```

<tr><td>

[PreloadTransportedQueryFunction](./client-react-streaming.preloadtransportedqueryfunction.md)

<tr><td>

[TransportedQueryRef](./client-react-streaming.transportedqueryref.md)

A `TransportedQueryRef` is an opaque object accessible via renderProp within `PreloadQuery`<!-- -->.

A child client component reading the `TransportedQueryRef` via useReadQuery will suspend until the promise resolves.

<tr><td>

[WrappedApolloProvider](./client-react-streaming.wrappedapolloprovider.md)

&gt; This is only available in React Client Components

A version of `ApolloProvider` particularly suited for React's streaming SSR.

[DataTransportContext](./client-react-streaming.datatransportcontext.md)

&gt; This export is only available in React Client Components

If you create a custom data transport, you need to wrap the child tree in a `DataTransportContext.Provider` and provide the `DataTransportAbstraction` to it.

See for example https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/blob/37feeaa9aea69b90a974eb9cd0fbd636b62d841a/integration-test/experimental-react/src/WrappedApolloProvider.tsx

## Type Aliases

Type Alias

[DataTransportProviderImplementation](./client-react-streaming.datatransportproviderimplementation.md)

Interface to be implemented by a custom data transport component, for usage with `WrapApolloProvider`<!-- -->.

This component needs to provide a `DataTransportContext` to it's children.

See for example https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/blob/37feeaa9aea69b90a974eb9cd0fbd636b62d841a/integration-test/experimental-react/src/WrappedApolloProvider.tsx

<tr><td>

[PreloadQueryProps](./client-react-streaming.preloadqueryprops.md)

<tr><td>

[PreloadTransportedQueryOptions](./client-react-streaming.preloadtransportedqueryoptions.md)

<tr><td>

[QueryEvent](./client-react-streaming.queryevent.md)

Events that will be emitted by a wrapped ApolloClient instance during SSR on `DataTransportProviderImplementation.registerDispatchRequestStarted`<!-- -->, to be transported to the browser and replayed there using `DataTransportProviderImplementation.onQueryEvent`<!-- -->.

# client-react-streaming.preloadquerycomponent.md

Source: https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/blob/main/docs/client-react-streaming.preloadquerycomponent.md

[Home](./index.md) &gt; [@apollo/client-react-streaming](./client-react-streaming.md) &gt; [PreloadQueryComponent](./client-react-streaming.preloadquerycomponent.md)

## PreloadQueryComponent interface

Preloads data in React Server Components to be hydrated in Client Components.

\#\#\# Example with `queryRef` `ClientChild` would call `useReadQuery` with the `queryRef`<!-- -->, the `Suspense` boundary is optional:

```jsx
<PreloadQuery
   query={QUERY}
   variables={{
     foo: 1
   }}
 >
  {(queryRef) => (
    <Suspense fallback={<>loading</>}>
      <ClientChild queryRef={queryRef} />
    </Suspense>
  )}
</PreloadQuery>
```
\#\#\# Example for `useSuspenseQuery` `ClientChild` would call the same query with `useSuspenseQuery`<!-- -->, the `Suspense` boundary is optional:

```jsx
 <PreloadQuery
   query={QUERY}
   variables={{
     foo: 1
   }}
 >
   <Suspense fallback={<>loading</>}>
     <ClientChild />
   </Suspense>
 </PreloadQuery>
```

```typescript
export interface PreloadQueryComponent 
```

---

# client-react-streaming.queryevent.md

Source: https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/blob/main/docs/client-react-streaming.queryevent.md

[Home](./index.md) &gt; [@apollo/client-react-streaming](./client-react-streaming.md) &gt; [QueryEvent](./client-react-streaming.queryevent.md)

## QueryEvent type

Events that will be emitted by a wrapped ApolloClient instance during SSR on `DataTransportProviderImplementation.registerDispatchRequestStarted`<!-- -->, to be transported to the browser and replayed there using `DataTransportProviderImplementation.onQueryEvent`<!-- -->.

```typescript
export type QueryEvent = {
    type: "started";
    options: TransportedOptions;
    id: TransportIdentifier;
} | (ReadableStreamLinkEvent & {
    id: TransportIdentifier;
});
```

# client-react-streaming.registerapolloclient.md

Source: https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/blob/main/docs/client-react-streaming.registerapolloclient.md

[Home](./index.md) &gt; [@apollo/client-react-streaming](./client-react-streaming.md) &gt; [registerApolloClient](./client-react-streaming.registerapolloclient.md)

## registerApolloClient() function

&gt; This export is only available in React Server Components

Ensures that you can always access the same instance of ApolloClient during RSC for an ongoing request, while always returning a new instance for different requests.

```typescript
export declare function registerApolloClient<ApolloClientOrPromise extends Promise<ApolloClient> | ApolloClient>(makeClient: () => ApolloClientOrPromise): {
    getClient: () => ApolloClientOrPromise;
    query: Awaited<ApolloClientOrPromise>["query"];
    PreloadQuery: PreloadQueryComponent;
};
```

## Parameters

Parameter

Type

makeClient

() =&gt; ApolloClientOrPromise

**Returns:**

{ getClient: () =&gt; ApolloClientOrPromise; query: Awaited&lt;ApolloClientOrPromise&gt;\["query"\]; PreloadQuery: [PreloadQueryComponent](./client-react-streaming.preloadquerycomponent.md)<!-- -->; }

## Example

```ts
export const { getClient, query, PreloadQuery } = registerApolloClient(() => {
  return new ApolloClient({
    cache: new InMemoryCache(),
    link: new HttpLink({
      uri: "http://example.com/api/graphql",
    }),
  });
});
```

---

# client-react-streaming.registerlateinitializingqueue.md

Source: https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/blob/main/docs/client-react-streaming.registerlateinitializingqueue.md

## registerLateInitializingQueue() function

Registers a queue that can be filled with data before it has actually been initialized with this function. Before calling this function, `window[key]` can just be handled as an array of data. When calling this funcation, all accumulated data will be passed to the callback. After calling this function, `window[key]` will be an object with a `push` method that will call the callback with the data.

```typescript
declare function registerLateInitializingQueue<K extends ValidQueueKeys>(key: K, callback: (data: Parameters<NonNullable<Window[K]>["push"]>[0]) => void): void;
```

## Parameters

Parameter

Type

key

K

<tr><td>

callback

(data: Parameters&lt;NonNullable&lt;Window\[K\]&gt;\["push"\]&gt;\[0\]) =&gt; void

**Returns:**

void

# client-react-streaming.removemultipartdirectiveslink.md

Source: https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/blob/main/docs/client-react-streaming.removemultipartdirectiveslink.md

[Home](./index.md) &gt; [@apollo/client-react-streaming](./client-react-streaming.md) &gt; [RemoveMultipartDirectivesLink](./client-react-streaming.removemultipartdirectiveslink.md)

## RemoveMultipartDirectivesLink class

This link will (if called with `stripDefer: true`<!-- -->) strip all `@defer` fragments from your query.

This is used to prevent the server from doing additional work in SSR scenarios where multipart responses cannot be handled anyways.

You can exclude certain fragments from this behavior by giving them a label starting with `"SsrDontStrip"`<!-- -->. The "starting with" is important, because labels have to be unique per operation. So if you have multiple directives where you want to override the default stipping behaviour, you can do this by annotating them like

```graphql
query myQuery {
  fastField
  ... @defer(label: "SsrDontStrip1") {
    slowField1
  }
  ... @defer(label: "SsrDontStrip2") {
    slowField2
  }
}
```
You can also use the link with `stripDefer: false` and mark certain fragments to be stripped by giving them a label starting with `"SsrStrip"`<!-- -->.

```typescript
export declare class RemoveMultipartDirectivesLink extends ApolloLink 
```
**Extends:** ApolloLink

## Example

```ts
new RemoveMultipartDirectivesLink({
  // Whether to strip fragments with `@defer` directives
  // from queries before sending them to the server.
  //
  // Defaults to `true`.
  //
  // Can be overwritten by adding a label starting
  // with either `"SsrDontStrip"` or `"SsrStrip"` to the
  // directive.
  stripDefer: true,
});
```

## Constructors

Constructor

# client-react-streaming.ssrmultipartlink.md

Source: https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/blob/main/docs/client-react-streaming.ssrmultipartlink.md

[Home](./index.md) &gt; [@apollo/client-react-streaming](./client-react-streaming.md) &gt; [SSRMultipartLink](./client-react-streaming.ssrmultipartlink.md)

## SSRMultipartLink class

A convenient combination of `RemoveMultipartDirectivesLink` and `AccumulateMultipartResponsesLink`<!-- -->.

```typescript
export declare class SSRMultipartLink extends ApolloLink 
```
**Extends:** ApolloLink

## Example

```ts
new SSRMultipartLink({
  // Whether to strip fragments with `@defer` directives
  // from queries before sending them to the server.
  //
  // Defaults to `true`.
  //
  // Can be overwritten by adding a label starting
  // with either `"SsrDontStrip"` or `"SsrStrip"` to the
  // directive.
  stripDefer: true,
  // The maximum delay in milliseconds
  // from receiving the first response
  // until the accumulated data will be flushed
  // and the connection will be closed.
  //
  // Defaults to `0`.
  //
  cutoffDelay: 100,
});
```

## Constructors

Constructor

Modifiers

[(constructor)(config)](./client-react-streaming.ssrmultipartlink._constructor_.md)

Constructs a new instance of the `SSRMultipartLink` class

---

## TeeToReadableStreamLink class

A link that allows the request to be cloned into a readable stream, e.g. for transport of multipart responses from RSC or a server loader to the browser.

export declare class TeeToReadableStreamLink extends ApolloLink

# client-react-streaming.transportedqueryref.md

Source: https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/blob/main/docs/client-react-streaming.transportedqueryref.md

[Home](./index.md) &gt; [@apollo/client-react-streaming](./client-react-streaming.md) &gt; [TransportedQueryRef](./client-react-streaming.transportedqueryref.md)

## TransportedQueryRef interface

A `TransportedQueryRef` is an opaque object accessible via renderProp within `PreloadQuery`<!-- -->.

A child client component reading the `TransportedQueryRef` via useReadQuery will suspend until the promise resolves.

```typescript
export interface TransportedQueryRef<TData = unknown, TVariables extends OperationVariables = OperationVariables> extends QueryRef<TData, TVariables> 
```
**Extends:** QueryRef&lt;TData, TVariables&gt;

## Properties

Property

Modifiers

Type

[toPromise?](./client-react-streaming.transportedqueryref.topromise.md)

undefined

_(Optional)_ Temporarily disabled - see https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/issues/332

Will now be be `undefined` both in React Server Components and Client Components until we can find a better resolution.

---

# client-react-streaming.transportedqueryref.topromise.md

[Home](./index.md) &gt; [@apollo/client-react-streaming](./client-react-streaming.md) &gt; [TransportedQueryRef](./client-react-streaming.transportedqueryref.md) &gt; [toPromise](./client-react-streaming.transportedqueryref.topromise.md)

## TransportedQueryRef.toPromise property

Temporarily disabled - see https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/issues/332

Will now be be `undefined` both in React Server Components and Client Components until we can find a better resolution.

```typescript
toPromise?: undefined;
```

## API Reference

## Packages

Package

[@apollo/client-integration-nextjs](./client-integration-nextjs.md)

<tr><td>

[@apollo/client-integration-react-router](./client-integration-react-router.md)

<tr><td>

[@apollo/client-integration-tanstack-start](./client-integration-tanstack-start.md)

<tr><td>

[@apollo/client-react-streaming](./client-react-streaming.md)

This package provides building blocks to create framework-level integration of Apollo Client with React's streaming SSR. See the \[@<!-- -->apollo/client-integration-nextjs\](https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/tree/main/packages/nextjs) package as an example.

It can also be used to use Apollo Client with a custom streaming SSR setup, e.g. with Vite. See the \[vite streaming integration test\](https://github.com/apollographql/apollo-client-integrations/tree/main/integration-test/vite-streaming) as an example.

---
